title: Roadrunner Boat Rental
specs: Top-rated by families, groups, and locals
Transparent pricing with no hidden fees
Popular routes include Lake Boca sandbar, Intracoastal cruise, sunset cruises, and fishing trips
Renters must be at least 35 years old or hold a valid Florida boating license
Anyone born on or after January 1, 1988 must carry a Florida Boater Education Card to operate a vessel of 10 HP or more
Valid photo ID and credit card required at pickup
Maximum 8 passengers, with life jackets provided for everyone
gap: Cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Rent clean, comfortable 24ft pontoons with shaded seating, Bluetooth stereo, and Bimini top. Rentals include gas, cooler with ice, floating mat, safety gear, and local route guidance. Self-drive only with full safety orientation and no prior boating experience required.
extraNote: Final quote confirmed by phone · No captained charters; all rentals are self-drive · 99 SE Mizner Blvd unit 600, Boca Raton, FL 33432

quotes.author: hal wasserman
quotes.text: Amazing experience, I'm a local guy and have been renting boats once in a while in Pompano Beach and that was one of the best experience I had, the owner was very nice, everything was ready when we showed up, the boat was really nice. He provided ice for us and a cooler, he was waiting for us at the dock when we arrived and the price was very competitive. Strongly recommend.

quotes.author: Scott Siegel
quotes.text: Nothing but good things to say about Roadrunner Boat Rental Boca Raton. Cristiano made the whole process of me taking my family on a really great afternoon boat right. He was on time, the boat was clean and ready to go. He took the time to teach me how to manage the boat and even suggested some great areas to visit. Highly recommend him for your next boat rental.

quotes.author: Eli Schwab
quotes.text: Excellent communication!! Extremely clear on instructions! Very conscientious on safety! Price was very reasonable and we had a blast!! Great outing for the family to boat thru the canal and swim around the sand bar after anchoring.
Roadrunner Boat Rental Boca Raton made our day on Lake Boca amazing! The boat was clean, the cooler and mat were a huge plus, and the local tips were spot on.
